summary: Describes how RTP is used in the context of CLUE, and the recommended ways to map RTP media streams described in SDP to CLUE media captures and scenes. This helps receivers know which incoming stream corresponds to which camera view. It is standards-track.

eli5.summary: A room with many cameras sends many video streams. This document explains how to put a name tag on each stream so the other side knows which camera it came from.

questions: how are rtp streams mapped to clue captures
